title: Single-atom tungsten doping induced chemical–electrochemical coupled pathway on Ni(OH)2 enables efficient urea electrooxidation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05340K, Paper
Lebin Cai, Haoyun Bai, Jilong Li, Feng Xie, Kang Jiang, Ying-Rui Lu, Hui Pan, Yongwen Tan
A chemical–electrochemical coupled pathway on Ni(OH)2 surface has been proposed for high-selectivity urea electrooxidation reaction (UOR) as the alternative of conventional oxygen evolution reaction (OER).
